name: Cable Technologies
old_description: Since being established in 1984, Cable Technologies has been known for an unparalleled commitment to customer satisfaction. It’s this standard of excellence that has provided the impetus for us to grow into the business we are today. For more information about the products and services we provide, reach out today.
about:
Cable Technologies was established in 1984 in Arlington, Texas, where it continues to operate from its facility at 3209 Avenue E East, Arlington, TX 76011. The company has not publicly identified its founders or specified its ownership structure, such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status.

The company specializes in the manufacture of custom wire harnesses and electronic and electrical cable assemblies. Its website lists these as its core product lines but does not provide details on the specific manufacturing processes, equipment, facility size, headcount, or annual production volumes.

Cable Technologies does not enumerate the industries it serves or the types of customers it targets on its public-facing pages. No concrete examples of client sectors or applications are mentioned.

The company states that it was built on an unparalleled commitment to customer satisfaction and a standard of excellence that has driven its growth since 1984. Beyond this general statement, no specific differentiators such as certifications, unique capabilities, or service guarantees are detailed. The business operates Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 7 p.m. Central Time.
